tei:div.tei:p: (423)yum ka'i rnam rgyal tshe sgrub 'don lugs ni/

bum pa/ tshe ril/ chang*/ mda' dar bcas bsham/ 'don 'grigs ni/ sems bskyed sdom chog nas/ yum ka'i bstod pa yan grub mtshams/ nang sgrub bde chen snying po las/ mkha' 'gro'i thugs dkar pad zla'i steng: gtsug gtor rnam rgyal gser mdog can: zhabs gnyis rta babs skyil mo krung: phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon pa ni: dkon mchog gsum mtshon skyabs sbyin rgyas: ut+pa lar gnas tshe bum 'dzin: 'od zer spro bsdus 'khor 'das kyi: dwangs bcud bdag la thim par gyur: oṃ pad+mo yo gi ni tā re tut+ta re a yur dā te bh+rūm̐ swa hā: zhes brgya/ bh+rūm̐ bh+rūm̐: dgu re la phreng rdog re bsgrangs pa'i phreng skor gcig gis dgu brgya dang stong song mtshams/ tshar dang po la yum ka'i las byang*/ mchod bstod/ yig brgya/ phyi ma rnams la/ ye shes lha tshogs/ tshe 'gugs ni/ tshe dbang mtshams sbyor las/ hūm̐: ye shes dbyings nas tshe 'gugs ma: bde gshegs sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma: dmar mo tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: chos kyi dbyings nas tshe khug (424)cig: hūm̐: nam mkha'i dbyings nas tshe 'gugs ma: sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro gshin rje mo: sngon mo tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: nam mkha'i khams nas tshe khug cig: hūm̐: rlung gi khams nas tshe 'gugs ma: rdo rje mkha' 'gro skyod byed ma: mthing nag tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: rlung gi khams nas tshe khug cig: hūm̐: me yi khams nas tshe 'gugs ma: rin chen mkha' 'gro sreg byed ma: ser mo tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: me yi khams nas tshe khug cig: hūm̐: chu yi khams nas tshe 'gugs ma: pad+ma mkha' 'gro rmongs byed ma: dmar mo tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: chu yi khams nas tshe khug cig: hūm̐: sa yi khams nas tshe 'gugs ma: las kyi mkha' 'gro tsan+t+ri ka: ljang gu tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: sa yi khams nas tshe khug cig: oṃ pad+mo yo gi ni tā re tut+ta re a yur dā te bh+rūm̐ swa hā: tshar dang po la tshig bzhi'i mtshams su sngags re re sbrags/

phyi ma rnams la gter gzhung ltar las mi dgos/ phyag (425)'tshal de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor: mtha' yas rnam par rgyal ba spyod ma: ma lus pha rol phyin pa thob pa'i: rgyal ba'i sras kyis shin tu sten ma: tshar bcu/ de nas mchod pa byin rlabs nas 'di yan grangs bsag grangs rdzogs dus rig 'dus tshe sgrub ltar/ āḥ 'byung lnga'i dbyings su 'khyams pa'i tshe: sogs rgyas gdab bya/ tshar rjes mar mchod phreng sbyar ba dang*/ gsol ka na rag skong bshags/ yum ka'i tshogs/ bshags pa/ skong bshags rdo rje'i thol glu/ mdor na rab 'byams= la gnam phud mchod/ drang ba/ lhag ma/ gsol ka bskyang*/ bskul chad brtan bro/ mchod bstod bshags/ dngos grub/ brtan bzhugs/ bsdu ldang*/ bsngo smon/ bkra shis bcas bya'o// dpal chen 'dus pas so// dge'o//
